ephemeralTeacherForcedLogits.temporaryCleanup: The evaluator removed the isolated temporary directory after SIGINT.

postmortemAssessment.explanation: With the inherited default path, sufficiently large FP16 activations can overflow during RMSNorm squaring. The reciprocal RMS becomes zero, so this mechanism can explain a finite but all-zero activation and logit tensor. The failed process retained no layer-level activation trace that could establish a unique cause.

proceduralDeviations.effectOnInterpretation: The byte-level lock and completed before/after reference-load revalidations establish identical source bytes, but the run must not be described as having used a read-only source snapshot.
proceduralDeviations.observation: The model directory and source-lock file were owner-writable when the formal run began.

proceduralDeviations.effectOnInterpretation: The sealed directory is a complete record of the interrupted process, not a complete ten-case experiment package.
proceduralDeviations.observation: After SIGINT the orchestrator wrote process metadata and a manifest, but the worker did not write worker-run.json, ten comparisons, aggregates, or unstarted per-case failure records.
